mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 67-degree temperatures with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library.

Verona residents can apply for a Stormwater Utility Credit to lower their bills by managing runoff with rain gardens or barrels. Additionally, the police department is currently reviewing information regarding a bus collision with a traffic sign following the arrest of a driver on October 15 for O W I.
You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, local fun continues with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior, though all students were reported safe.
Head over to Culver's today to enjoy the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day; the store is open until 10:00 PM.
